messages:
maria: Quick async check-in — overnight 2xx spike and follow-ups. I rolled back canary on svc-inference at ~01:10 UTC and muted the noisy alert rule for 30m while investigating. Details: saw batching backlog + CPU climb on a single shard.

alex: thanks — saw the rollback, nice catch. i pushed a tiny runbook tweak: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-investigation (PR 482). added note to check `--batch-window` metrics. :thumbsup:

samir: oncall handover note: after rollback we recovered to baseline but redis latency alerts still fired twice. looks like transient network flaps to the replica set; i restarted instance r3 in eu-west-1 at 02:05 and it stabilized.

maria: noted. i'll open a follow-up ticket to track replica flakiness (linked to incident). can someone check if autoscaler logs show any pod churn around the same time?

alex: i grabbed autoscaler logs — there was one scale-up due to queue depth spiking, then scale-down after rollback. putting a short comment on the PR with the snippet:
```
kubectl logs -n infra autoscaler-7bd9 | grep "scale up" -A3
# shows scale up at 00:58, scale down at 01:15
```

tanya: thanks. i'll take the ticket to tune alert thresholds (redis latency -> require sustained 3m instead of 1m) and add a suppression rule for canary tag. assigning to me. :spiral_notepad:

dan: FYI i'm going to schedule a tiny maintenance window on wed 03:00-03:30 UTC to rotate that replica cert and run a quick connectivity test. should reduce flakiness. will update calendar and notify oncall.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback for svc-inference (sha: d4c9f) completed at 01:12 UTC — monitoring for 30m.

maria: last item — can we do a quick alert ownership check? current paging rota doesn't match runbook owners for svc-inference alerts. if owners can't be confirmed i'll put temporary coverage on eng-sre. @samir @alex please ping your teams if needed.

samir: will ping infra-apps, should have confirmation by EOD.

alex: pinged platform-owners, also adding a test in CI to ensure canary tag propagation.

maria: great — thanks everyone. i'll file the incident summary and link the ticket here once ready. :white_check_mark:
